comment: MINOS v2 Quality Engine test suite. Each case: { query, mode, context, expectedPatterns, shouldPass }. consumed by minos-orchestrator during CP2. 50+ cases covering QG1–QG6 across all 8 modes.
engine: validateOutput(output, mode, context) -> { pass, issues, score }
